title: Field of a stack block is read after its region has ended (exclave_ in both arms of an if)
summary: A field read from a stack-allocated block is computed after the region has ended when the function ends with `exclave_` calls of a local function in both arms of an `if`; the slot has been reused by then. With a string field the program ends with a segmentation fault.
cause: In `middle_end/flambda2/to_cmm/`, the pure load, used once, is substituted into the handler of a continuation with two uses (`to_cmm_expr.ml`, `let_cont_not_inlined`), which runs after `End_region` in each arm; the flush before `End_region` finds no use of it in the arm.

fix.text: Translates the handler of a continuation that is not inlined in an environment from which no delayed binding is substituted, and flushes before the continuation every binding that the handler uses. Builds; `test.ml` then prints the expected result; testsuite unchanged.

reference: related: issue #4803 (a call moved after a load; not the same)
